status: User-confirmed two-wheel flow and inclusive reward thresholds; twelve environment/stat/power pairings are editable authored initial curation, not a user-confirmed final roster

confirmed: Roll a harsh environment first, including freezing tundra, volcano core, acid pool, nuclear wasteland and space.
Then roll Survival Chance from 0% through 100% in 12.5-percentage-point steps.
At <=37.5% give +1 point worth of environment-related stat buff.
At >37.5% and <=75% give its environment-related power.
At >75% give both that power and the same stat buff.
Some environments can be much harsher than others; no equal-power balancing is required.
authority.existingPolicy: Unspecified wheel probabilities are equal; every environment baseWeight 1 and each of nine chance outcomes 1/9.
authoredInterpretations: The +1 stat package is exactly +1 numeric point on one main stat, not +1 on all stats or a tier increase.
Twelve environment choices and their linked stat/power recipes are editable authored design; only five environment themes were explicit examples.
0% falls into the first reward band and still grants +1; no additional survival/death check or character cancellation was requested.

contracts.order: Actual Survivalist role/reaction -> one Environment spin/reaction -> one Survival Chance spin/reaction -> one stat modifier, one fixed power grant or both -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Equal weights per wheel: twelve authored environment choices 1/12 each; nine chance results 1/9 each. The displayed chance percentage is the selected value, not that outcome's draw probability. No automatic hardship/race/power/stat modifiers, unavailable-body filters, rarity or higher reward from environment severity.
contracts.chance: Values 0,12.5,25,37.5,50,62.5,75,87.5,100. Treat as a fictional spin result driving the specified reward; do not make a second Bernoulli/death roll, reroll zero or infer actual death/survival.
contracts.rewards: <=37.5 stat-only; >37.5 and <=75 power-only; >75 both. Power-only never adds the stat buff. Both uses exactly the same +1 stat/power recipe, not double stats, another power selector or an environmental immunity package.
contracts.stat: Apply one +1 numeric main-stat modifier from the selected recipe after the immutable recipient base under configured limits. No extra resistance, mastery, Size or probability bonus is inferred.
contracts.power: Grant the environment-linked intrinsic power directly, without Element/Cosmic/Race/Sin/hero subflow. Reuse canonical definitions where already present; new definitions live once here. Source context comes from Survivalist, not the other caller race/season/hero. Limits remain; manipulation does not automatically imply immunity.
contracts.mastery: All grants are ordinary owned powers under the recipient one shared current/future Power Mastery; no rank bonus, God Authority override, extra mastery spin or Enchant. Grants survive a later normal Power None.
contracts.severity: Keep thematic hazard differences. Hazard text is game context, not a sourced mortality estimate or a numerical difficulty/stat scale. Do not rebalance, add tier multipliers or bias chance from severity without a new rule.
contracts.ledger: Freeze version, environment pool/recipe and chance pool before seeded sampling. Commit each actual result/reaction once; consume the source-scoped reward key atomically for the power and stat together. Resume/re-render uses saved snapshots/results with no redraw or duplicate reward.
contracts.reaction: Environment beat reveals only the committed environment. Reward is known only after actual chance result. Fixed grant/modifier creates no extra spin or funny-result mechanics tag; existing Shrek hook runs only if an actual catalog-tagged spin is separately configured.
